keys: V4 native_motion.%s 不认识（只有 clips / variants / states / exits / yield）
en: V4 native_motion.%s unrecognized (only clips / variants / states / exits / yield allowed)

keys: V4 native_motion.yield 须是帧条名数组
en: V4 native_motion.yield must be an array of anim strip names

keys: V4 native_motion.clips 须是 {槽: 秒}

en: V4 native_motion.clips.%s must be positive seconds

keys: V4 native_motion.variants 每条须是 {slot, use} 加 perm: 0–2 或 node: 成长节点 id（二选一）
en: V4 native_motion.variants each entry requires {slot, use} plus perm: 0-2 or node: Growth node id (choose one)

keys: V4 native_motion.states 每条须有 on 与 slot
en: V4 native_motion.states entries must each have on and slot

en: V4 native_motion.states '%s' requires 0 ≤ from ≤ to < frames %d, rate ≥ 0 (or write loop: true)

keys: V4 native_motion.exits 每条须是 {on, slot, from < 帧数, tail > 0}
en: V4 native_motion.exits each entry must be {on, slot, from < frames, tail > 0}
